title: MORE ENERGY PLEASE!
body: I agree with several of the other reviews that you burn through Energy in about five minutes, and then you have to watch ad after ad or purchase more energy in order to keep playing the game. Many other games I play have multiple side games or “bonus rounds“ where you can get extra extra energy to continue playing. It would be nice if you added more things like this to this game. It is also incredibly annoying that several of the goals include mushrooms and pasta items, but when you click on the campfire, you get three times as many hotdogs, etc. as you do pasta. When you click on the basket, you get three times as many fruit items as you do mushrooms. It makes it incredibly hard to get the pasta dishes and mushroom items. Please make the ratio of these items more even. Because once again, if you’re burning through all your energy in five minutes just trying to get one mushroom or one pasta dish, it just makes you wanna give up on the game altogether.
